parties.respondent: The Government of Andhra Pradesh & ORS.

summary: Preventive detention under Andhra Pradesh Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act, 1986; detention based on repeated involvement in bootlegging; grounds supported by four criminal cases involving illegal possession, transport, and sale of illicit liquor; failure to secure mediators not fatal to prosecution; chemical analysis confirmed illicit nature; detention order upheld for maintaining public health and public order.
legal_provisions_cited: Andhra Pradesh Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders and Land Grabbers Act, 1986 s.3(2), s.2(b)
